findings.note: Observed actual completed-file/container checks, original formats, bounded format/cookie fallback and filtered logging. Existing end-to-end media proof is snapshot-specific; no new product capability inferred.
Observed validated public HTTP inputs, privacy-preserving errors and shared surfaced-rate-limit priority. Static messages preserve actionable failure classes without raw credentials.
Observed deterministic existing/bundled FFmpeg resolution and typed status; presence is not execution proof, which is separately recorded for exact artifacts.
Observed supported MP4/WEBM/MP3/M4A labels, exact quality choices and legacy label migration, corroborating documented downloads.

Observed malformed/unreadable history could be overwritten or interrupt queue completion. RED proved changed old bytes, leftover temp and stalled queue; repaired preservation, unique atomic publication/cleanup and explicit save outcome while retaining valid legacy records.
Observed privacy filtering before handlers plus bounded rotating file logs. No generated log contents or private user data were recovery evidence.

Observed real Qt controls, queue, plain-text logs and safe thread-aware close. RED proved MP3 quality resetting to Best through normal settings/busy transitions; repaired retention for every supported quality. History warnings now preserve successful queue completion.

Observed explicit source/frozen diagnostic uses temporary settings/history/output, native widgets, worker and optional authorized download. Fixture export is not independent live archive/installer acceptance.
Observed dev/frozen resource and user-data ownership paths plus filename sanitization; transcript root confinement has separate manifest/path validation and hostile-path evidence.
Observed diagnostics report actual local versions/paths/runtime detection. Callable/authenticated/reviewed/verified remain separate; file detection alone is not operational acceptance.
